```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(salmonMSE)
library(here)
library(kableExtra)
```

## Benchmarks


```{r benchmarks, echo=FALSE}
BenchFull <- read.csv(file = here("tables", "BenchmarksFull_NatPops.base.csv"))

kable(BenchFull, 
      caption = "Table 1. Populaton-level benchmarks, with SMAX estimated from the conditioning model", booktabs = TRUE) %>% 
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>% 
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

# Alternative
BenchSimple <- read.csv(file = here("tables", "BenchmarksSimple_NatPops.base.csv"))

kable(BenchSimple, 
      caption = "Table 1. Population-level benchmarks", booktabs = TRUE) %>% 
  collapse_rows(columns = 1, valign = "top") %>% 
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE)

```

```{r smax, echo=FALSE}

Smax_hab <- as.data.frame(
  read.csv(
    here("data", "UpperSoGChinook_posteriorpredictive_Sept25_iter1.csv"))) %>% 
  select("Stock", "WA", "logSMAX_median", "SMAX_lwr025", "SMAX_upr975") %>% 
  rename(Population = "Stock", WatershedArea = "WA", SMAX = "logSMAX_median", 
         lwr = "SMAX_lwr025", upr = "SMAX_upr975") %>% 
  mutate(SMAX = exp(SMAX), lwr = exp(lwr), upr = exp(upr)) %>% 
  filter(Population %in% c("Adam/Eve", "Nimpkish", "Salmon"))
```
